name: layerlens
description: A design-tool viewer for live, cross-origin page previews: hover and select any element, browse a lazy-loaded layers tree, and inspect live styles, all across iframes using postMessage only.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
